notes: Florence is walkable; the centre has a ZTL (restricted traffic zone) and cars are banned. Take the bus (SITA) to Siena and San Gimignano, and a car or tour for Chianti. Tram T2 goes to the airport.
Book timed online tickets for the Uffizi, the Accademia and the dome weeks ahead. Museums are free on the first Sunday of the month (crowded). The Firenze Card costs 85 EUR for 72 hours.
Summer brings 33-36°C heat and crowds. Visit museums at 08:15, rest at midday for the siesta, and go to Piazzale Michelangelo at 19:30. In August, some places close for Ferragosto.
Lampredotto is 5 EUR, schiacciata 8 EUR, a trattoria meal 20-30 EUR and bistecca 50-60 EUR/kg. Coperto (cover charge) is 2-3 EUR and a coffee standing at the bar 1.30 EUR.
Tap water is safe to drink. Shoulders and knees must be covered in the Duomo and churches.
The Vasari Corridor has reopened (reserve through the Uffizi).

stops.name: Cattedrale di Santa Maria del Fiore
stops.tips: Entry to the cathedral is free (expect a queue). The Brunelleschi Pass (30 EUR) covers the dome, bell tower, baptistery and museum.

stops.name: Brunelleschi Kubbesi Tırmanışı
stops.tips: 463 steps, timed slots that book out weeks ahead. You climb past frescoes to a view over the city.

stops.name: Battistero di San Giovanni
stops.tips: Ghiberti's Gates of Paradise (copy) and the mosaic ceiling. Included in the pass.

stops.name: Mercato Centrale Firenze
stops.tips: Market on the ground floor, food hall upstairs. Try lampredotto (tripe sandwich) at Nerbone and a truffle sandwich.

stops.name: Piazza della Signoria
stops.tips: An open-air sculpture museum: Loggia dei Lanzi, the Neptune Fountain and a copy of David.

backups.name: All'Antico Vinaio
backups.tips: The schiacciata sandwich shop with the queue, on Via dei Neri.

backups.name: Museo dell'Opera del Duomo
backups.tips: The original Gates of Paradise and Michelangelo's Pietà. Included in the pass.

stops.name: Galleria degli Uffizi
stops.tips: Botticelli's Venus, Leonardo, Caravaggio. Book the first slot at 08:15 online (29 EUR) and allow 2.5 hours.

stops.name: Ponte Vecchio
stops.tips: The jewellers' bridge, with the Vasari Corridor above.

stops.name: Trattoria Sergio Gozzi
stops.tips: A local trattoria in San Lorenzo since 1915. Come at lunch for ribollita (Tuscan bread soup) and bistecca.

stops.name: Basilica di San Lorenzo & Medici Chapels
stops.tips: Michelangelo's sculptures in the New Sacristy and the Medici tombs.

stops.name: Piazzale Michelangelo
stops.tips: The postcard view of the city, best at sunset. The church of San Miniato is 10 minutes uphill (Gregorian chant at 17:30).

backups.name: Trattoria Mario
backups.tips: Lunch at shared tables opposite the market. Cash only.

backups.name: Palazzo Vecchio
backups.tips: The town hall and the Hall of the Five Hundred, with views from the tower.

stops.name: Galleria dell'Accademia
stops.tips: Michelangelo's David and the Prisoners. Book the 08:15 slot online.

stops.name: Museo di San Marco
stops.tips: Monastery cells painted with frescoes by Fra Angelico. Quiet.

stops.name: Mercato di Sant'Ambrogio
stops.tips: A local market with the Cibrèo café and Trattoria da Rocco (inside the market).

stops.name: Basilica di Santa Croce
stops.tips: Tombs of Michelangelo, Galileo and Machiavelli, plus Giotto's frescoes.

stops.name: Scuola del Cuoio
stops.tips: A leather school behind Santa Croce where you can watch the workshop.

backups.name: Museo Galileo
backups.tips: Scientific instruments. An alternative to Santa Croce.

stops.name: Palazzo Pitti Galleria Palatina
stops.tips: The Medici palace, with Raphael and Titian. Combined ticket with the Uffizi is 40 EUR.

stops.name: Giardino di Boboli
stops.tips: A Renaissance garden with the Neptune pool and a route through to the Bardini garden.

stops.name: Giardino Bardini
stops.tips: Entry with your Boboli ticket. Look for the wisteria tunnel (April-May) and the view of the Duomo.

stops.name: Gustapizza Oltrarno
stops.tips: Neapolitan pizza near Santo Spirito. Expect a queue.

stops.name: Piazza Santo Spirito
stops.tips: The square of the artisans' quarter, with Brunelleschi's church and workshops (Via Maggio). Aperitivo in the evening.

backups.name: Il Santo Bevitore
backups.tips: Oltrarno's well-known dinner restaurant. Reserve ahead.

backups.name: Cappella Brancacci
backups.tips: Masaccio's frescoes in Santa Maria del Carmine. Reserve ahead.

stops.name: Piazza del Campo Siena
stops.tips: 1.5 hours by bus. A shell-shaped square, and the Palio (2 July-16 August).

stops.name: Duomo di Siena
stops.tips: A black-and-white striped cathedral with the Piccolomini Library and a marble floor (uncovered August-October).

stops.name: Torre del Mangia
stops.tips: A 400-step tower with views over the Campo.

stops.name: Osteria Le Logge Siena
stops.tips: Tuscan cooking next to the Campo. Try the pici (thick hand-rolled pasta).

stops.name: San Gimignano Towers
stops.tips: The medieval Manhattan, with 14 towers. Stop at Gelateria Dondoli (world-champion ice cream) and walk the walls at sunset.

backups.name: Monteriggioni
backups.tips: A village with round walls. A closer alternative to San Gimignano.

stops.name: Greve in Chianti
stops.tips: The capital of Chianti, with a triangular square and Antica Macelleria Falorni.

stops.name: Castello di Verrazzano Wine Tour
stops.tips: A tour of the castle's vineyard with a tasting. Reserve ahead; go by tour or car.

stops.name: Castello di Verrazzano Lunch
stops.tips: A Tuscan lunch in the vineyard, served with wine.

stops.name: Panzano in Chianti
stops.tips: Dario Cecchini's butcher village, home to the poetry-reciting butcher.

stops.name: Castellina in Chianti
stops.tips: An Etruscan tunnel and town walls, with vineyards at sunset.

backups.name: Badia a Passignano
backups.tips: An abbey and the Antinori vineyards. An alternative to Verrazzano.

days.theme: Santa Maria Novella: a gentle farewell

stops.name: Basilica di Santa Maria Novella
stops.tips: Masaccio's Trinity, next to the station.

stops.name: Officina Profumo-Farmaceutica di Santa Maria Novella
stops.tips: A pharmacy and perfumery since 1221. Good for souvenirs.

stops.name: Trattoria Sostanza
stops.tips: Famous for its butter chicken breast since 1869. Cash only, lunch.

stops.name: Firenze Santa Maria Novella Station
stops.tips: Pisa is 1 hour away and Rome 1.5 hours. The airport is 20 minutes by tram T2. Time to say goodbye.

backups.name: Museo Novecento
backups.tips: 20th-century art. An alternative to the basilica.
